title: Collection of Biological Samples With Clinical Characterization of Covid-19 Patients
brief_summary: Biological collection (blood sample) associated with clinical data from Covid-19 patients
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Diagnosis of COVID-19 confirmed on RT-PCR test or chest scanner
* Any age
* Membership in the general social security system
* Inform consent signed by the patient or by legal representatives for minors

Exclusion Criteria:

* Refusal of the patient or one of the legal representatives
